value.title: pij Rust port — foundations (the mold)
value.summary: Build the pij Rust mold: cargo workspace, injectable ports, drift enforcement, exemplars — fs3 plan 001 pattern applied to pij.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Plan 108 does not port pij features — it builds the mold the port is poured into, cloning flowspace3 plan 001 (fs3-foundations) per Jordan's ruling that lynx's designs are authoritative. Deliverables: a cargo workspace with the pij crate layout (core with no tokio/no IO, adapter crates, daemon+cli as two composition roots in ONE binary, testkit with shipped fakes); minimal port traits with fake-as-default config so everything runs offline; a mechanical architecture-drift gate (dep-graph vs committed allowlist with per-row rationale, negative-tested); the queue primitive decision and state-store ruling (SQLite vs files vs PG) workshopped before code; exemplar tests at every tier later plans copy; and a hello-depth binary where 'pij ping' round-trips CLI->daemon over localhost HTTP with a per-boot bearer key. Exit bar: a fresh agent implements any later port unit by copying shapes already present, and architecture violations go red mechanically before review. Prior art: /Users/jordanknight/substrate/flowspace/flowspace3/scratch/rust-port-handover/ (PACKET.md, INTERVIEW-ANSWERS.md Q3, TENETS.md, fs3-architecture.md).

sections.name: goals
value: Cargo workspace with the pij crate layout, compiling end-to-end at hello-world depth: core (no tokio/no IO), store, tmux, harnesses, daemon, cli (one binary, two composition roots), testkit.
Ports in the flesh: minimal object-safe traits in core, adapters own wire quirks, one composition root wires Arc<dyn Port>, config selects the adapter, fake is the default — offline-first.

Architecture drift detected mechanically: crate-dependency allowlist test with per-row rationale + fmt/clippy -D warnings wired into the gate, negative-tested (add a forbidden dep, check goes red, revert).
State-store and queue-primitive rulings made and recorded before any feature plan: SQLite vs files vs PG workshop, handler/job split, dedupe index, advisory-lock serialization.
Exemplar tests at every tier later plans copy: pure-core unit (no doubles), port contract over a fake, store integration, CLI golden against the TS binary (parity tripwire).
Hello-depth daemon+CLI: pij-rs daemon boots with fakes, serves /health on localhost with per-boot bearer key; pij-rs ping reports healthy; NDJSON event stream with Unknown variant.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Porting any real pij verb beyond ping/health — the verb surface fans out in later plans per the unit table.
Bug-for-bug replication of the TS defect list before its fix-vs-bug-compatible rulings (lynx 8-defect list rides the requirements pot, ruled per item at unit dispatch).
Daemon supervise/upgrade story beyond a named design note — fs3 admits theirs is weak; ours lands as its own plan.
Cutover, side-by-side soak, or retiring the TS CLI — a dedicated later plan behind the parity harness.
Real provider/harness network-or-tmux calls as a gate requirement — fakes suffice; real adapters are compile-proven stubs.

value.claim: From a clean checkout, documented steps yield green cargo build --workspace and cargo test --workspace.
Crate graph matches the ratified workshop layout; core compiles with no tokio/sqlite/HTTP dependencies.
Drift check FAILS when a forbidden dependency is added (negative test: add tokio to core, gate goes red, revert).
State-store ruling (SQLite vs files vs PG) and handler/job split are recorded as workshop decisions before any service unit is dispatched.
Daemon boots with fake adapters selected via config, serves /health on localhost with per-boot 0600 bearer key; pij-rs ping reports healthy.
Exemplar tests pass at all tiers: core unit with zero doubles, port contract over a deterministic fake, store integration, one CLI golden diffed against the TS binary output.
Gate runs fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, full tests and the drift check, all green, from one command.
README quick-start + architecture doc exist; a fresh agent can implement a later unit by copying shapes already present.

value.title: Phase 1: Foundations — workspace, ports, drift enforcement, exemplars
value.brief: The whole mold in one phase: scaffold the workspace, land the architecture as code, enforce it mechanically, leave one exemplar of everything. Unit split + signatures live in services.dd.json (impl-guide) beside this plan.
